{"id":"JMAP-tna1.3.3","title":"jmap-server history.rs: ObjectHistoryBackend, history get/query/queryChanges/set machinery","description":"Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H3. Crates: jmap-server. Size: L.

Spec: object-history-03 §3, §3.1, §4, §5.1, §7.3/7.4, §8.2, §8.5. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 (whole section), §6, §10 (srv contract tests).

New module crate-jmap-server/src/history.rs plus one lib.rs export line. Leave helpers.rs functions unchanged.

Contents:
- ObjectHistoryBackend: JmapBackend with REQUIRED methods (no defaults; spec-method-defaults rule):
  - object_history_capability (sync)
  - get_object_history<O: HistoryObject>
  - query_destroyed: the minted query_state MUST encode the destroyed-query kind (decision 6(c))
  - query_destroyed_changes: Ok(None) iff the state is not a destroyed-query state
  - restore_object
  Rustdoc carries the full contracts of note §6, including:
  - decision 6(d): a destroyed object whose final version was discarded is notFound
  - the id-reuse ban
  - the /changes restore classification
  - blob rules for blobext and legacy RFC 9404 lookup (decision 11)
  - §8.2 access rules
- Support types: HistoryGetParams, DestroyedQueryParams<O>, HistoryGetResult<O>, Restored<O>. All #[non_exhaustive] with new + setters.
- Parsers: HistoryGetRequest::parse, DestroyedQueryRequest::parse, RestoreRequest::parse.
- Wrappers handle_get_with_history, query, and handle_query_changes_with_history. queryChanges calls query_destroyed_changes first and falls through to the plain handler on Ok(None).
- Pub pieces for custom getters: strip_object_history_property, attach_object_history.
- run_restore_phase with a RestoreHooks trait for per-type pre-checks and an optional type-specific patch parser. Includes parent-first ordering for tree types.
- apply_restore_patch (a changed SERVER_SET/IMMUTABLE value ⇒ invalidProperties; an identical value is allowed), restored_diff, append_restore_results (restored/notRestored are null when empty, present whenever the URI is in using).
- enforce_max_objects_in_set_with_restore: create+update+destroy+restore (decision 6(a)).
- Dispatcher::register_history_aware(name, handler) marks a method; plain register clears the mark. Dispatcher::object_history_gaps(supported_types).
- Interim D2 rule: in history handlers, without the URI in using, a true flag, onlyDestroyed:true or a non-null restore ⇒ invalidArguments.

Acceptance: mock-backend contract tests, every bullet of note §10 'srv contract tests', including:
- historyLimit:"x" ignored when both flags are false
- a flag on an unsupported type ⇒ invalidArguments
- objectHistory in properties without a flag is neither an error nor returned
- destroyedAfter:null alone accepted
- state-kind routing of queryChanges
- restore {} ≡ null; non-object patch ⇒ invalidPatch
- restore runs before an update of the same id; oldState is read before the restore
- objectHistory in create ⇒ invalidProperties
- maxObjectsInSet counts restores
- Other redacted to serverFail
- object_history_gaps flags a plain re-registration
